items.title: File Einspruch against the Grundsteuerwert-Fortschreibung
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch beim Finanzamt Musterweilburg eingelegt werden, schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: Letter states the posting day (Aufgabe zur Post) as Saturday 21.11.2026 and itself invokes the 4-day deemed-delivery rule of §122 Abs.2 Nr.1 AO (post dispatched from 2025 onward). Counting from 21.11.2026: day 1 = Sun 22.11, day 2 = Mon 23.11, day 3 = Tue 24.11, day 4 = Wed 25.11.2026 → deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on Wed 25.11.2026 (a business day, no shift needed). Under §108 Abs.1 AO / §187 Abs.1 BGB the one-month Einspruch period starts the following day, 26.11.2026. Per §188 Abs.2 BGB the month ends on the day numerically corresponding to the start event: 25.12.2026. That day (Fri 25.12.2026) is 'Erster Weihnachtstag', a public holiday in NW; the following day, Sat 26.12.2026 ('Zweiter Weihnachtstag'), is also a holiday and a Saturday; Sun 27.12.2026 is a Sunday. Per §108 Abs.3 AO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 28.12.2026.

warnings: The letter is dated 18.11.2026 (Mittwoch) but states it was posted (Aufgabe zur Post) on Saturday 21.11.2026 — unusual but not necessarily wrong; if the person can prove it actually arrived later than the deemed delivery of 25.11.2026, the one-month period would start later and the deadline would move accordingly — worth checking the envelope postmark if kept.

This assessment only fixes the Grundsteuerwert (184,300 €); no Grundsteuer payment is set or due from this letter itself — a separate Grundsteuermessbescheid and then the municipality's Grundsteuerbescheid will follow, so no amount is currently payable.

An IBAN is printed in the letter's footer, but the letter does not request any payment; this appears to be the Finanzamt's standard account information rather than a demand — do not use it to pay anything based on this letter alone.
